settings.heading: house rules
settings.rule_2: no real names, numbers, handles or links. nothing that could identify anyone.
settings.rule_3: no hate, harassment or bullying. no selling.
settings.rule_4: your alias is the only name anyone sees. we don’t ask for a name, email or account.
settings.privacy: to stop spam, we keep a scrambled code for your device (never your IP address) and delete it within 30 days.
settings.moderation_prelaunch: once posting opens, talks and replies go live straight away. we take down whatever breaks these rules.
settings.moderation: talks and replies go live straight away. we take down whatever breaks these rules.
settings.report: tap report on anything that breaks these rules. three reports from different people and it’s hidden until we’ve checked it. something here about you? email {email} with the link and we’ll take it down.
settings.support: if a talk gets heavy, you don’t have to carry it alone. call Tele-MANAS, India’s free 24×7 mental health helpline, on 14416 or 1800-891-4416.
